query:
SELECT r.tenant_id AS "tenant_id: TenantId",
                   t.name      AS "name!",
                   t.slug      AS "slug!",
                   r.role      AS "role: Role"
              FROM user_tenant_role r
              JOIN app_user u ON u.id = r.user_id
              JOIN tenant   t ON t.id = r.tenant_id
             WHERE r.user_id = $1 AND u.disabled_at IS NULL
             ORDER BY t.name, r.tenant_id
